mapper.select: SELECT id, kind, status, fee_rate, pool_total, sum_fee, dust, sum_payout, winner_positions, loser_positions, done_at FROM settle_run WHERE market_id = #{marketId} AND kind = #{kind}

SELECT i.market_id, i.option_id, i.win, i.stake, i.fee, i.payout FROM settle_item i JOIN settle_run r ON r.id = i.run_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND r.kind = 'PAYOUT' AND r.status = 'DONE' AND i.market_id IN #{m}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.stake), 0) AS stake, COALESCE(SUM(i.payout), 0) AS payout, COALESCE(SUM(i.fee), 0) AS fee FROM settle_item i JOIN settle_run r ON r.id = i.run_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND r.kind = 'PAYOUT' AND r.status = 'DONE'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM settle_compensation_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND market_id = #{marketId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM settle_refund_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND market_id = #{marketId} AND status = 'DONE'
